run_gguf_dump_metadata: run the gguf_dump script to dump GGUF file metadata in human-readable text format
run_gguf_dump_json: run the gguf_dump script to dump GGUF file metadata as JSON output
run_gguf_dump_markdown: run the gguf_dump script to dump GGUF file metadata as a formatted markdown document
run_gguf_dump_data_offset: run the gguf_dump script to print the data offset of a GGUF file
run_gguf_dump_data_alignment: run the gguf_dump script to print the data alignment of a GGUF file
